sources.name: Hand-authored seed facilities
sources.coverage: 30 real mines, smelters and refineries across copper, lithium, cobalt and rare earths. Coordinates are approximate. Replaced by the ICMM Global Mining Dataset and IEA extracts once the ETL runs.

sources.name: Hand-authored seed trade flows
sources.coverage: 28 country-to-country flows for 2024, on a contained-metal basis. Replaced by the ADB-WTO TiCM bilateral trade database once the ETL runs.

sources.name: Indicative annual average prices
sources.coverage: One average price per mineral per year, used to derive estimated flow values. Order-of-magnitude only. Replaced by the World Bank Pink Sheet once the ETL runs.

sources.name: Representative country centroids
sources.coverage: 26 countries. Hand-picked representative land points used as arc endpoints, not computed polygon centroids. Replaced by a public centroid dataset once the ETL runs.

sources.name: USGS National Minerals Information Center
sources.coverage: Commodity background cited on individual seed facility records. Not yet machine-extracted.
